# fl_updater

> Flutter plugin that shows an app-update dialog (soft/snoozable or blocking force update) driven by a remote JSON config, and opens the App Store / Play Store natively. Provider-agnostic: config comes from Firebase Remote Config (`fl_updater_firebase`) or your own API (`ApiConfigProvider`).

This package lives in a Dart pub workspace (repo root: https://github.com/kishormainali/fl_updater) (Dart >=3.6, Flutter >=3.27):
- `packages/fl_updater` (this package) — core: `FlUpdater`, `FlUpdaterWrapper`, `FlUpdaterConfigProvider`, `ApiConfigProvider`, `UpdateInfo`, `UpdateService`, dialogs, snooze store, native store-opening (Kotlin/Swift).
- `packages/fl_updater_firebase` — `FirebaseConfigProvider` (depends on `firebase_remote_config`; core does not).
- `example/` — sample app.

## Usage

`provider:` is required on both entry points.

```dart
// Declarative (recommended): wrap the app in MaterialApp.builder
MaterialApp(
  builder: (context, child) => FlUpdaterWrapper(
    provider: FirebaseConfigProvider(), // or ApiConfigProvider(fetch: ...)
    iosAppId: '123456789',              // required on iOS for store redirect
    androidPackageId: 'com.example.app', // defaults to host app id
    child: child!,
  ),
);

// Imperative
final updater = FlUpdater(provider: provider);
final info = await updater.checkForUpdate();
await updater.showUpdateDialog(context, info: info);
```

Own API (no Firebase): `ApiConfigProvider(fetch: () async => jsonString)` — the callback must return the `fl_updater_config` JSON as a `String` (use `jsonEncode` if your client decodes it). No push updates; re-fetched on each check.

Custom backend: implement `FlUpdaterConfigProvider { Future<String?> fetch({Duration minimumFetchInterval}); Future<String?> current(); Stream<void>? get changes; }`. `changes` may be `null` (no push). After an event, `current()` must return the new config.

## Config JSON schema (`fl_updater_config`)

```json
{
  "min_version": "1.0.0",
  "latest_version": "1.2.0+5",
  "platforms": { "android": { "latest_version": "1.3.0",
                  "flavors": { "staging": { "min_version": "1.1.1" } } } },
  "flavors": { "staging": { "latest_version": "1.1.1" } }
}
```
`min_version` / `latest_version` resolve independently, most specific first: `platforms[p].flavors[f]` → `platforms[p]` → `flavors[f]` → top level. Versions may include a build number (`x.y.z+n`). Status: installed < `min_version` → force; installed < `latest_version` → soft (snoozable, default 3 days); otherwise none.

## Behaviour notes

- `enabled` defaults to `!kDebugMode`; it is the master gate (no fetch, no listener when false). Pass `enabled: true` to test in debug.
- Failures fail open: any fetch/parse error yields `UpdateStatus.none`; a fetch error falls back to `provider.current()`.
- `flavor` defaults to Flutter's `appFlavor`; `platform` defaults to `android`/`ios`.
- `enableLogging` (per call/instance) or `FlUpdater.enableLogging` (global) turns on `fp_logger` output under tag `fl_updater`.

## Source map

- [config_provider.dart](lib/src/providers/config_provider.dart): provider interface
- [api_config_provider.dart](lib/src/providers/api_config_provider.dart)
- [update_service.dart](lib/src/services/update_service.dart): fetch → evaluate → snooze policy
- [update_info.model.dart](lib/src/models/update_info.model.dart): JSON schema resolution, `UpdateInfo`
- [update_wrapper.dart](lib/src/widgets/update_wrapper.dart): `FlUpdaterWrapper`
- [firebase_config_provider.dart](https://github.com/kishormainali/fl_updater/blob/main/packages/fl_updater_firebase/lib/src/firebase_config_provider.dart)

## Optional

- Tests: run `flutter test` inside each package directory (`packages/fl_updater`, `packages/fl_updater_firebase`, `example`).
